annotations.title: Move a booking to another date (customer confirms by email code)

description: Moves an existing home-cleaning booking, or one visit of a recurring plan, to another date. Two calls: 1) without verification_code - checks the request and emails a 6-digit code to the address on the booking; 2) ask the customer for the code and call again with the same arguments plus verification_code - the booking is moved. Free of charge, allowed only when both the current and the new date are at least 48 hours away (terms, article 7.4); otherwise use send_message or call 01 89 19 68 69. One-off booking: date and/or arrival window. Recurring plan: one visit at a time, date only (the arrival window stays the plan's); the first visit and frequency changes cannot be done here.

email.description: Email address used for the booking

new_arrival_window.description: One-off bookings only: start of the 2-hour arrival window from get_time_slots, e.g. "14:00". Omit to keep the current window.

new_date.description: New date, YYYY-MM-DD, at least 48 hours away (see get_time_slots)

verification_code.description: 6-digit code from the email, second call only

visit_date.description: Recurring plans only: current date of the visit to move
